data.title: Lucid Sonic Dreams
data.content: Syncs GAN-generated visuals to music. By default uses NVLabs StyleGAN2-ada (StyleGAN XL version also now available) with pre-trained models lifted from Justin Pinkney's consolidated repository. Custom weights and other GAN architectures can be used as well. Though StyleGAN determines some of the stylistic output, the adjustable parameters of this tool allows for some range of creative malleability. It is interoperative with sonic workflows, producing reciprocal responses to audio inputs. Pollinator maintain a Discord community.

data.title: Facet
data.content: Facet offers easily-accessible T2I image generation with postproduction tools, and fine-tunable, personalised, sharable models. They do not open source the code for their proprietary tooling, however their tooling is built on Stable Diffusion 1.5, which is open source, with dreambooth training. Facet host a Discord channel and offer small grants for artists.

data.title: BabyAGI
data.content: Built for OpenAI's API and Task-Driven Autonomous Agent (2023) this is a minimal task management system which will perpetually generate new tasks towards some goal based on the outcome of the previous task.

data.title: StabilityLM
data.content: Stability's Large Language Model, beginning at 3 or 7m parameters with future expansions planned. The model is open source, and Stability are transparent about their use of The Pile dataset to train the model. They publish to their community via their 'Stable Digest' Substack newsletter, and openly advocate for open source models to be published for transparency and scrutiny.

data.title: SplineAI
data.content: AI add-on for Spline 3D design tool. Prompt-based co-piloting for 'jamming' with Spline. It is a proprietary tool and as such the code is not available open source to evaluate. Spline hosts a Discord channel for its community, and is specifically designed to bridge AI with a wider design toolkit.
